Points a buffer holds: `count` points and no `points`, each placed by the material's positionNode reading `vertexIndex`, inside `bounds` (the room they stand in, as an instance set's). Unlit; no collider. | { kind: "custom"; geometry: BespokeGeometrySpec; forward?: ForwardAxis; sockets?: PrimitiveSockets } // Custom geometry primitive (bespoke mesh) | { kind: "scripted"; script: ScriptRef; params?: Record<string, unknown>; seed?: number; forward?: ForwardAxis; sockets?: PrimitiveSockets } // Scripted geometry primitive: script exports geometry() and optional collider(); collider() may return a heightfield: an object's ground from a grid of heights (`spawn api ColliderHeightfield`) | { kind: "points"; count: number; bounds?: { min: [number, number, number]; max: [number, number, number] } } // Points primitive (three's Points): `count` points, drawn by the object's scripted PointsNodeMaterial (`spawn api builtin/three`): its positionNode places point `instanceIndex` in the object's frame, sizeNode sizes it in CSS pixels, colorNode and opacityNode colour it. `bounds` (min/max, metres in the object's frame) is the room the points stand in: the object is skipped where the eye does not see it, and `.bounds` reads it. // PrimitiveSpec, every kind but "line" | "custom" | "scripted" | "points" sockets?: Record<string, { x: number; y: number; z: number } | [number, number, number] | { position: { x: number; y: number; z: number } | [number, number, number]; direction?: { x: number; y: number; z: number } | [number, number, number] }> // Named points in the shape's own frame (metres from the feet, before scale): a child's `attachment: { socket }` anchor and the socket read's answer. The renderer ignores them. // PrimitiveSpec, kind "pyramid" thetaStart?: number // Internal: the canonical form's base turn (π/4 for a width × depth base so the corners sit on the axes' diagonals). // PrimitiveSpec, kind "lathe" points: Array<[number, number]> // 2D profile points [x, y] where x is distance from axis, y is height // PrimitiveSpec, kind "extrude" shape: Array<[number, number]> | string // outline: [x, y] points (y up) or SVG path data (subpaths = outline + holes) holes?: Array<Array<[number, number]>> // point-list holes cut from the outline, [x, y] (y up) // PrimitiveSpec, kind "torusKnot" p?: number // Knot parameter p q?: number // Knot parameter q // PrimitiveSpec, kind "superellipsoid" a?: number // X-axis radius b?: number // Y-axis radius c?: number // Z-axis radius n1?: number // North-south rounding parameter n2?: number // East-west rounding parameter // PrimitiveSpec, kind "archway" width?: number // outer width of the frame height?: number // outer height of the frame depth?: number // extrusion depth (wall thickness) thickness?: number // frame member thickness // PrimitiveSpec, kind "squareArch" width?: number // total width (default 6) height?: number // total height (default 8) depth?: number // thickness/extrusion (default 1) archWidth?: number // width of the arch opening (default: width * 0.6) archHeight?: number // height of the arch apex (default: archWidth/2 for semicircle) segments?: number // smoothness of arch curve (default 16) // PrimitiveSpec, kind "wall" width: number // span along the wall face depth: number // wall thickness holes?: Array<{ x: number; bottomY?: number; y?: number; w: number; h: number }> // center-x, bottomY, width, height facing?: "z" | "x" | "y" // which axis the face is perpendicular to (default: "z") // PrimitiveSpec, kind "custom" forward?: ForwardAxis // The axis the mesh was modelled to face (default "-z"); the engine turns the geometry to −Z once. A child's `feetPosition` does not turn: it stays in the object's frame, whose front is −Z. sockets?: PrimitiveSockets // Named points in the modelled frame (metres from the feet): a child's `attachment: { socket }` anchor and `getObjectSocket`'s answer. // PrimitiveSpec, kind "scripted" params?: Record<string, unknown> // The script's ctx.params. A param whose value is `{ samples: "/cdn/value.<sha>.png" }` (an uploaded PNG) arrives as its pixels (`spawn api GeometryContext`); a bare address stays a string. seed?: number // Deterministic seed for ctx.random/noise (default 0). Scatter templates that omit it get a per-instance seed, so scattered instances vary; set it explicitly when every instance should be identical. forward?: ForwardAxis // The axis the script's geometry was modelled to face (default "-z"); the engine turns every emitted vertex, normal, collider point and socket to −Z once, at the derive. A child's `feetPosition` does not turn: it stays in the object's frame, whose front is −Z. // PrimitiveSpec, kind "points" count: number // how many points, one round point a copy (instanceIndex 0 to count − 1), each placed by the object's PointsNodeMaterial (builtin/three): positionNode, sizeNode in CSS pixels

// PrimitiveSpec, kind "extrude"

  holes?: Array<Array<[number, number]>>   // point-list holes cut from the outline, [x, y] (y up)

// PrimitiveSpec, kind "torusKnot"
  p?: number   // Knot parameter p
  q?: number   // Knot parameter q

// PrimitiveSpec, kind "superellipsoid"
  a?: number   // X-axis radius
  b?: number   // Y-axis radius
  c?: number   // Z-axis radius
  n1?: number   // North-south rounding parameter
  n2?: number   // East-west rounding parameter

// PrimitiveSpec, kind "archway"
  width?: number   // outer width of the frame
  height?: number   // outer height of the frame
  depth?: number   // extrusion depth (wall thickness)
  thickness?: number   // frame member thickness

// PrimitiveSpec, kind "squareArch"
  width?: number   // total width (default 6)
  height?: number   // total height (default 8)
  depth?: number   // thickness/extrusion (default 1)
  archWidth?: number   // width of the arch opening (default: width * 0.6)
  archHeight?: number   // height of the arch apex (default: archWidth/2 for semicircle)
  segments?: number   // smoothness of arch curve (default 16)

// PrimitiveSpec, kind "wall"
  width: number   // span along the wall face
  depth: number   // wall thickness
  holes?: Array<{ x: number; bottomY?: number; y?: number; w: number; h: number }>   // center-x, bottomY, width, height
  facing?: "z" | "x" | "y"   // which axis the face is perpendicular to (default: "z")

// PrimitiveSpec, kind "custom"
  forward?: ForwardAxis   // The axis the mesh was modelled to face (default "-z"); the engine turns the geometry to −Z once. A child's `feetPosition` does not turn: it stays in the object's frame, whose front is −Z.
  sockets?: PrimitiveSockets   // Named points in the modelled frame (metres from the feet): a child's `attachment: { socket }` anchor and `getObjectSocket`'s answer.

// PrimitiveSpec, kind "scripted"
  params?: Record<string, unknown>   // The script's ctx.params. A param whose value is `{ samples: "/cdn/value.<sha>.png" }` (an uploaded PNG) arrives as its pixels (`spawn api GeometryContext`); a bare address stays a string.
  seed?: number   // Deterministic seed for ctx.random/noise (default 0). Scatter templates that omit it get a per-instance seed, so scattered instances vary; set it explicitly when every instance should be identical.
  forward?: ForwardAxis   // The axis the script's geometry was modelled to face (default "-z"); the engine turns every emitted vertex, normal, collider point and socket to −Z once, at the derive. A child's `feetPosition` does not turn: it stays in the object's frame, whose front is −Z.

// PrimitiveSpec, kind "points"
  count: number   // how many points, one round point a copy (instanceIndex 0 to count − 1), each placed by the object's PointsNodeMaterial (builtin/three): positionNode, sizeNode in CSS pixels
